thread:
maya: FYI scheduling a short rolling maintenance in apac-southeast1 tonight 23:00-00:30 SGT (UTC+8). Root cause: intermittent NVMe timeouts under heavy KV-cache warmup that occasionally triggers longer driver retries. Aimed to be low-impact but expect brief p99 spikes during each node drain.

maya: High-level plan:
- 23:00 start: pick 3 cohorts (~10% pool each). cordon+drain cohort1 -> validate -> cohort2 -> cohort3
- Canary on two nodes first, check KV reseed and generation latencies
- Driver reload + nic micro-retry kernel param tweak, then uncordon and allow KV cache reseed (~5m)
- Smart routing to eu-west1 for non-pinned sessions if p99 crosses threshold

maya: Exact canary commands I'll run:
```
# cordon + drain gracefully
kubectl cordon gpu-node-canary-01
kubectl drain gpu-node-canary-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=600s
# after patch + smoke
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-canary-01
```

maya: Abort/rollback triggers (if any hit -> stop window):
- p99 generation latency > 2x baseline for 2+ mins
- /v1/generate 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3+ mins
- Dedicated pool throughput <85% of commit for >5 mins
- Any correlated customer-facing 5xx spike from cohort nodes

oncall-ryan: I'll be oncall. Who owns KV-cache warm metric watch? I'll set alerts per abort criteria.

maya: Ryan, can you watch apac p99 tokens, kv_reseed_keys, and api_5xx_rate? I'll do node ops and driver reloads.

sara: Support ask: please pre-notify Dedicated customers with >1% committed capacity affected. We should avoid surprises for latency-sensitive pipelines.

javier: I'll draft the customer blurb. Recommend "brief rolling maintenance, possible short latency spikes; no expected downtime for Hosted API". Also add CSM contact if they see impact.

leo: Routing question: will overflow to eu-west1 be automatic? Any e2e latency or stateful shard impacts?

maya: Yes, smart routing will overflow non-pinned sessions to eu-west1. Note: cross-region traffic increases egress cost ~6-12% during burst and may add ~40-80ms RTT. Pinned Dedicated sessions remain on apac unless we explicitly relocate them.

javier: Draft notice (wip):
"Redwood maintenance: apac-southeast1 rolling node drains + driver update tonight 23:00-00:30 SGT. Hosted API expected to remain available; brief latency spikes possible. Contact support if >10% errors observed"

sara: lgtm pending Ryan confirming metric watchers. I'll coordinate posting to #customer-success and emailing Dedicated opt-ins.

ops-bot: maintenance record created: id=mn-2026-0199, window=2026-06-12T23:00+08:00 -> 2026-06-13T00:30+08:00

maya: Canary checklist to run:
- drain completes within 5m and pods rescheduled
- kv_warm_keys >= 80% within 7m of uncordon
- validate p50/p95/p99 vs baseline
- internal canary smoke client (5rps) shows no 5xx

oncall-ryan: I'll configure the telemetry board: apac-southeast1/gpu/p99_tokens, kv_reseed_latency, api_5xx_rate and set Alert thresholds to abort criteria.

leo: Ops-cost question: if overflow sustains >20m, do we need to pre-commit capacity in eu-west? Finance wants heads-up: could be ~$3k-6k of extra egress/GPU usage depending on burst.

maya: No manual reserve planned. Autoscaler + routing should absorb most. If we force overflow >20m we'll escalate to finance and consider temporary commit.

sara: I'll prepare the customer notice and tag CSMs; Javier add the CSM list.

javier: Added CSMs and pinging @pm-ellen for product comms.

pm-ellen: Please cc me on mid-market notices; we may offer mitigation for customers running synchronous pipelines.

deploy-bot: queued canary deploy: canary-client-v2 -> canary-group-42, expected warmup ~3m after traffic shift.

maya: Post-window verification tasks:
- confirm all nodes uncordoned
- validate kv seed stability for 15m
- confirm rollout metrics and close ticket
- publish postmortem if abort/incident occurs

oncall-ryan: ack. I'll update the runbook live if anything deviates. Ping this thread with anomalies.

sara: :thumbsup:

javier: :eyes: Draft notice posted in 10m.

maya: Thanks all. I'll paste runbook link and specific canary node names 30m before start.
